items.imagegen_prompt: Create ONE original fantasy collectible GAME CARD BACK, portrait 2:3, front-on and full-bleed. The supplied image is the USER-APPROVED STYLE AND FRAME reference for this complete seven-card set. Match its cool restrained 2D illustrated finish, layered matte slate surfaces, selective material detail, precise tapered drawing, antique gold edge highlights, muted red/teal accent hierarchy and premium dark fantasy mood. Match the enclosing frame's visual weight: substantial angular charcoal corner plates, small gold diamonds, continuous metallic side/top/bottom bands and a clear inset border. Keep ALL FOUR sides and FOUR CORNERS complete and clearly visible. The new card has its OWN central theme below; use the reference's finish and frame grammar, not its koi, coin-hole or brocade objects. Maintain a strong readable central silhouette, quieter decorative backdrop and ample inset space around the focal motif. This is a 2D illustrated asset, not a photo or 3D render. No text, letters, numbers, logos, UI, characters, tabletop, product mockup or outside margins. Theme: TRAVELLER'S CANVAS. Large folded ochre canvas panels open around a dark diamond-shaped portal in the center, like a travel charm made from an old pack. A small but crisp turquoise four-point compass-star gleams inside the opening. A thick muted-teal rope loops behind the portal and winds through the lower folds like a road. A dark vertical reinforcing strip echoes the reference's strong center axis. Give the canvas a believable restrained illustrated weave and a few substantial stitched seams, with subtle worn fabric planes rather than busy brush flakes. Slate/umber backdrop, muted honey canvas and concentrated turquoise. Sparse map-like route arcs on the quiet side panels; no writing. Use the same charcoal metallic enclosing frame, with muted brass corners and tiny rope-seam accents.
